instructions: Each volume is a JSON array of family records. Use all keys in this example. Text should be original educational design; citations support mathematics, not claims of classroom validation. Aim 400-650 words per family, sufficient to facilitate a planning-level trial. Do not fill advanced branches with dishonest elementary analogies. All listed instances require a correct solution. The coordinator will render this structure directly.

example_record.title: A specific investigable question
example_record.adult_question: What makes this mathematics interesting at an undergraduate or research level?
example_record.anchor: A precise theorem, definition, construction or problem, with hypotheses.

source.title: Author and title
source.checked: full relevant text / excerpt only / continuation not verified

bridge.preserves: What the learner's objects and moves realize
bridge.limits: What this does not establish about the advanced field

gates.explore: What additional capability supports sustained exploration
gates.prove: What is needed for the stated general theorem
gates.reading: None with oral launch / short rules / symbolic text
gates.reasoning: Tracking, spatial, abstraction or language demands
gates.hard_stop: Where prerequisites become essential; no grade requirement

example_record.materials: Concrete objects or sketches; practical preparation
example_record.launch: An exact, child/adolescent-facing prompt, including legal actions
example_record.session: 0-10 explore; 10-15 launch; 15-35...; 35-40 reset; 40-55...; 55-60 share. Customize to actual activity. Card is a menu, not requirement to finish.

example.solution: Checked result and enough reasoning to verify it
example.boundary: A counterexample, degenerate case or limitation with an explanation

extensions: A genuinely deeper question with direction or answer
example_record.satisfying_stop: A worthwhile result without needing the advanced proof
example_record.prior_use: Existing related activity and what differs; exact old instances are not new activities. Unknown actual use remains unknown.
